content.title: About
content.content: Turnover is a ready‑to‑eat seafood mix that includes shrimp, mussels, squid and fish, pre‑seasoned and lightly fried in aromatic spices. It is designed for quick home cooking and is popular in Asian and Mediterranean cuisines.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turnover is often sold in vacuum‑sealed packs that keep the product fresh and flavorful for up to 12 months.
The mix may contain seaweed extracts, which boost iodine content and add an umami note.
In Japan a similar product is called “mizu‑moti” and is used as a filling for sushi rolls.
Shrimps are usually peeled but keep the tail for visual appeal.
The product freezes well; thawing is best done in the refrigerator for 8‑12 hours.

items.title: Rich in omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Seafood provides EPA and DHA, which support heart and brain health.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Turnover delivers a complete set of essential amino acids for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The mix contains zinc, selenium, vitamin B12 and vitamin D, important for immunity and metabolism.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with red meat, seafood has less saturated fat, making it more heart‑friendly.

items.title: Supports bone health
items.content: Iodine and vitamin D aid calcium absorption, helping to strengthen bones.

items.title: Seafood allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience severe allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Prepared mixes often contain added salt; people with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Food‑borne illness risk
items.content: Improper storage or thawing can allow bacterial growth leading to food poisoning.

items.title: Possible contaminants
items.content: Seafood can contain trace amounts of heavy metals (mercury, cadmium); moderate consumption is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Thaw the mix in the refrigerator, then stir‑fry on high heat for 3‑5 minutes with soy sauce, garlic and ginger. Serve with rice, noodles or fresh vegetables. It can also be added to salads, soups or used as a filling for rolls.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen Turnover at –18 °C or lower. Once thawed, use within 24 hours and store in the refrigerator at +2…+4 °C. Do not refreeze.
